Title:
NETMESSAGE:This is the Corduroy Caterpillar, good to hear from you ground team! 
 How is the mission going? 
 
 Vis-screen says you can't proceed without some aerial bombardment aid, 
 Well... That can certainly be arranged!
Translation:
这里是 Corduroy Caterpillar，很高兴听到你们地面队伍的声音！
 任务进展如何？
 
 视觉屏显示，如果没有空中轰炸支援，你们无法继续前进，
 嗯……这当然可以安排！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Reports say this fortress hides something: \n the Cyber Lords' mythical superweapon project ''The Basilisk'' \n Well, if it is that, it could swing the war gentlemen!
Translation: 报告称这座堡垒隐藏着某种东西：\n 赛博领主们的神话级超级武器项目“The Basilisk” \n 嗯，如果是那个，它可能会扭转战局，先生们！

Title:
NETMESSAGE:You will have to find and destroy this ''Basilisk'' 
 you will be rewarded handsomely for your bravery! 
 
 I'm talking more vestment magazines in the break room, 
 entirely new kinds of soda pop in the vending machine!
Translation:
你们必须找到并摧毁这个“Basilisk” 
 你们将因勇敢而获得丰厚奖赏！
 
 我说的是休息室里更多的背心杂志，
 自动售货机里全新种类的汽水！

Title: NETMESSAGE:On the topic of drinks, any refrigerators nearby? \n That is where the cyborgs store their new super stimulants. \n Have a look around, could give you an advantage!
Translation: 说到饮品，附近有冰箱吗？\n 那是半机械人存放新型超级兴奋剂的地方。\n 四处看看，或许能给你们带来优势！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Drinks... Where was I?... Oh right, go get that ''Basilisk'' \n This is Corduroy Caterpillar over and out, \n commencing bombing you out of that room!
Translation: 饮品……我说到哪了？……哦对了，去干掉那个“Basilisk” \n 这里是 Corduroy Caterpillar，通话结束，\n 开始轰炸，把你们炸出那个房间！
